app_name: ADHD Habit Tracker, To Do List
title: Perfect habit tracking app for me
body: The look, the feel and the functionality of the app are exactly the factors I'm looking for a habit tracking app that is perfect for me. This app can help you build a good habit as well as limit a bad one. You can specify if you're building or limiting a habit and you can then track your progress, your streaks as well as the time you've spent on a habit since there's also a session tracking feature! I really like the app and I'm looking forward to more updates! Amazing app and an even more amazing developer!
